title: Tech Lead
profile: Full-stack engineer who takes ambiguous features from a blank page to a shipped system: scoping the problem, proposing the architecture, aligning the team, and delivering it. Comfortable across the stack (Spring Boot, NestJS, Kotlin, Rust, Vue/Nuxt, React), with practical DDD and service-boundary experience from production work and a hands-on monolith-to-microservices migration exercise. I mentor teammates directly and have caught data-correctness issues before they reached production. No production .NET Core or React Native yet, but I pick up stacks fast.

education.institution: Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology
education.degree: BSc Computer Science with MTN Bright Scholarship Reloaded. First Class Honours

bullets: Owned the Bonus Period feature end to end from an open-ended ask: scoped it into a lifecycle state machine (upcoming, active, computing, finance review, finalized, closed) and presented it to align the team on a new shared computation model.
Published computed bonus data to Kafka for consumption by Amalitech's payroll service, restructuring the payload to match their spec and coordinating directly with them on the contract.
Proactively flagged access-control risks to the Product Owner ahead of incidents, and caught a data-correctness bug before it reached production.
Mentored teammates directly: set up mock-server backend integration for one colleague, walked another through scoring/configuration internals, and paired on frontend pipeline fixes.
Architected JWT/RSA authentication with SSO and RBAC across six roles; enforced data integrity via PostgreSQL triggers and kept 70%+ test coverage (JaCoCo, Hurl E2E) with rate limiting.

2.5+ years progressively owning backend systems for a health-tech platform: cloud storage, verification flows, PDF generation, real-time notifications (SSE, WebSocket), and an EMR migration from TSOA to NestJS/Prisma with zero data loss.

projects.name: Food Delivery Platform: Microservices Migration (AmaliTech Training Academy)
bullets: Completed a hands-on architecture lab decomposing a Spring Boot monolith into four bounded-context services with service discovery (Eureka), an API gateway with edge JWT auth, RabbitMQ event-driven communication, and Resilience4j circuit breakers, containerized via Docker Compose.
Designed and delivered a full-stack nonprofit website end to end, live in production (NuxtJs/Vue 3/TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Vercel), owned from schema through UI.

projects.name: Adzesua: Multi-Tenant School Management Platform
bullets: Rewrote a multi-tenant school-management backend from a legacy Kotlin/Ktor service to Rust (Actix Web, SeaORM, PostgreSQL with row-level security for tenant isolation): tenant onboarding, fee structures, and installment billing with Paystack webhook-verified payments.
